title: chrysanthemum longibracteatum
intro: Chrysanthemum longibracteatum, commonly known as the narrow-leaved chrysanthemum or Chinese chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the sunflower family that is native to China and other parts of Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of the common cold and flu. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum longibracteatum include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
